'''Volume 53''' is the 53rd volume of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga and the second volume in the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]].

In [[VIZ Media]]'s translation, this volume is published as volume two of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black 2 & White 2".

==Blurb==
''Whitley is beginning to have feelings for Inspector Blake, but it seems all he cares about is figuring out if she is a Team Plasma spy planted at their school. A chorus tournament in Castelia City strikes some sour notes when the Seven Sages crash the event. And then, who will save Legendary Pokémon Kyurem from Team Plasma…?''

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Blake}} battles {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus}}.
* Blake's class wins the [[Autumn Choir Tournament]], and [[Roxie]] takes them to [[Castelia City]].
* [[Hugh's sister]] secretly follows the group. 
* After finding an injured man, Roxie, Blake, {{adv|Whitley}} and [[Hugh]] make their way to [[Castelia Sewers]].
* [[Colress]] confronts [[Zinzolin]] at the abandoned [[Cold Storage]] and finds out that he succeeded in catching {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}} {{MangaArc|Black & White|two years earlier}}.
* Blake fights Colress. 
* Whitley finds out about the rift in [[Team Plasma]], the [[Colress Machine]], and the microchip in her pendant. She decides to find the pendant in order to give it to [[Rood]] or [[Gorm]].
* Hugh finds out that Whitley is a former member of Team Plasma.
* [[Ghetsis]] appears together with the [[Plasma Frigate]].
* Colress kidnaps Zinzolin and takes control of Kyurem, placing it inside the Plasma Frigate.
* Blake sneaks into the Plasma Frigate.
* The Plasma Frigate freezes Castelia City, and Whitley is captured.
* Whitley realizes that Blake is a member of the [[International Police]], and he handcuffs her.
* Whitley decides to co-operate with Blake.
* Colress has Kyurem freeze Blake, Whitley, and [[Kelden|Keldeo]], and the three are tossed into the ocean.
* {{adv|N}}, {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}}, and the [[Light Stone]] are seen flying above the ocean.
